DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection)

The blood culture showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility is pathognomonic for Listeria monocytogenes. Given your pregnancy status and history of eating unpasteurized ice cream, this is a confirmed diagnosis of listeriosis, which requires immediate antibiotic treatment.
